mapped.protocol: Three independently launched alternating windows with three warmups and nine measurements per process; two additional alternating confirmation windows when any initial ratio exceeds 1.05. Native batches: admission64/fresh16/cycle1. WASM batches: admission64/fresh64 (one when arguments exceed 1024 bytes)/cycle1. Fresh runs immediately resume every public yield; cycle additionally saves/restores at quantum one. Both include protocol encoding and outcome decoding. No exclusive-host claim.

measurementNotes: Frozen P15 semantic compiler produces byte-identical controls. Structural and local cost comparisons share exact input/image tuples.
Native and WASM memory are working payload; host buffers/RSS are excluded. Quantum-one and quantum-64 checkpoint cycles are separate. No memory/checkpoint threshold violation is waived.

Native traffic counts use FailingAllocator around complete Session admission/execution/deinit, excluding compiler image encoding. They are separate from Workspace peak and uninstrumented latency. The unchanged World writer materializes both concat segments; total payload construction remains quadratic: k*N*(N+1)/2 concatenated elements plus k*N chunk elements. Output storage remains O(N).
All timing processes ran after builds stopped. Authoring observations may overlap builds and establish no compiler speedup.

The 18 Agent images are unchanged. Earlier pre-cutover cumulative reports and separate pending M3/P13 decisions retain their original attribution; these synthetic fixtures have no historical application timing to relabel.
